startup_capture_unavailable: Live startup experiments need a Rust capture adapter. Opening this page or selecting a shared device does not run an experiment.
startup_configuration_notice: Capture configuration is unavailable until the Rust experiment adapter is connected; it does not configure imported reports.
startup_filter_notice: Mode cards filter the imported requested mode, not the observed mode. All runs are shown until a filter is chosen.
startup_imported_notice: Imported CSV declarations are not independently verified. TTID/TTFD are not reconstructed from TotalTime or Agent callbacks.
startup_low_samples: Fewer than 20 TTID samples: tail-percentile resolution is limited.
startup_empty: Choose Import startup CSV to inspect launch evidence. Device capture is not connected.
startup_phases_unavailable: This CSV has no correlated milestone timestamps or phase intervals. Phase durations remain unavailable; launch durations are not additive phases.
startup_no_matches: No runs match this requested-mode filter.
startup_baseline_unavailable: A comparable experiment, stable device/target identity and compilation/environment evidence are required. CSV imports do not establish these conditions; no regression delta is inferred.
startup_no_compilation: No compilation or Profile evidence for the selected run.
startup_no_findings: No additional imported diagnostics. This is not proof of an optimized startup.
startup_fully_drawn_hint: TTFD is unavailable without reportFullyDrawn evidence; it never falls back to TTID.
startup_export_scope: Exports contain the published runs page only, not a lossless experiment report. JSON/CSV page exports are not Startup CSV import files.
startup_select_run: Select a measured run to inspect its evidence.
startup_imported_source: Imported CSV · confidence not independently verified
startup_environment_missing: Device/thermal/battery evidence is absent from this import.
startup_trace_unavailable: An imported path/capture declaration is not a verified trace or clock correlation. Rust trace navigation and startup root-cause adapters are not connected.
